statusDetail: Coverage-complete model audit of five representative public paths. Excluded: authenticated post-login workflows, real application submission requiring identity/data, PDF contents, and the external ksavisa.sa site.

paths.description: Public landing page, service chooser, visa-status lookup form, launch modal, and consent surface.
Representative service-listing archetype for visitor visa tasks.
Representative authentication path, including national SSO and legacy account sign-in.
Recovery state for an invalid route.

findings.summary: The site does not honor the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-preference screenshot is visually indistinguishable from the light rendering, and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define preference-driven light/dark surface, text, control, and image treatments.

findings.summary: A non-essential 10-second animation continues under reduced motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched prefers-reduced-motion: reduce but still found a running animation with duration 10000 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable auto-advance and non-essential animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Page and state changes are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition usage across the inspected MPA routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively add same-origin cross-document View Transitions, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The large navigation chrome does not react to scroll position.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no scroll-state/container or scroll-timeline support while screenshots show persistent multi-row header/banner chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll-state queries or a simple sticky-state treatment to reduce chrome and preserve orientation after scrolling.

findings.summary: Help tooltips rely on legacy scripted positioning rather than resilient anchored positioning.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains tooltip links and Bootstrap scripts, while the CSS probe found no anchor-name or position-anchor usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for contextual help.

findings.summary: A launch modal and consent banner obscure the primary service and lookup content on arrival.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile load screenshots show a centered promotional modal plus a bottom consent banner covering most of the first viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Move the promotion to an inline, non-blocking notice and keep consent compact, reversible, and non-obscuring.

findings.summary: The launch experience uses custom Bootstrap div dialogs with incomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence found div.modal elements with role=dialog; axe reports the visible dialog has no accessible name.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog or popover as appropriate, wire an accessible name, focus management, Escape, and light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Promotional and consent chrome displaces core content on every representative route.
findings.evidence: Service, login, and support screenshots show the KSA Visa banner and bottom consent layer consuming substantial viewport area.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve the first viewport for the current task; collapse repeated promotion/consent chrome after first acknowledgement.

findings.summary: Reusable cards and forms adapt only through legacy viewport styling.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container rules despite card/form components being reused in different page regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable components containment and size-aware container-query layouts, retaining a fallback where needed.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated and several targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The active-control probe reports outline-style none for sampled links/fields and multiple controls at 12–41 px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 44×44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: The main page misses the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.5 s (performance 0.73); the independent trace measured LCP 4075.66 ms and FCP 3573.56 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce document/server delay, and defer non-critical promotion and scripts.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is slowed by many blocking resources and weak cache/compression hygiene.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 8 parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets, synchronous classic scripts, an uncompressed 56 KB document, and missing cache headers on major assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline or consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, compress HTML, and set durable cache headers on versioned assets.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable CSS and legacy dependency overhead.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 55 KiB of unused CSS; HAR shows 9 stylesheets and 12 scripts for a small landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused rules and conditionally load validation, Select2, and route-specific scripts only where needed.

findings.summary: Core lookup controls and contextual help lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Axe reports critical label/select-name/image-alt failures, unnamed tooltip links, and an unnamed launch dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate every field with a label, name icon-only controls, describe the CAPTCHA appropriately, and label the dialog.

findings.summary: Navigation and service text fail WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: Axe measured ratios of 4.34:1 and 3.38:1 for normal-sized text, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the affected purple text tokens and retest all states against their actual backgrounds.

findings.summary: Heading, landmark, and keyboard-focus structure is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Axe reports invalid heading order and content outside landmarks; the focus probe found no visible outline on sampled controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use main/nav/header/footer landmarks, correct heading order, and a consistent visible :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: Although mobile reflow works, several interactive targets remain too small.
findings.evidence: Mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow, but the modality probe measured links and help icons as small as 12×12 px and key controls below 44 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target hit areas without changing visual density, and verify at 200% zoom and narrow reflow.

findings.summary: The document lacks a doctype and image sizing metadata.
findings.evidence: DOM/Lighthouse report no HTML doctype; the image audit found all 6 images missing explicit width and height.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <!doctype html> and intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for every image.

findings.summary: Pages use a generic title and omit meta descriptions.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found title “منصة التأشيرات” and no meta description; representative routes reuse the same title.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each archetype a unique descriptive title and concise Arabic/English meta description.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable and robots.txt is unusable.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found javascript: and # hrefs; Lighthouse crawlable-anchors and robots audits score 0, and /robots.txt returns a request-rejected HTML page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations or buttons for actions and serve a valid text/plain robots.txt.

findings.summary: Canonical, sitemap, and consistent indexing signals are missing.
findings.evidence: Probe found no canonical; sitemap.xml returned an empty body and robots.txt was blocked, despite public routes returning 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical links, a valid sitemap, and consistent robots/indexing policy for public pages.

findings.summary: The public government service has no structured or social-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: Probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph metadata on the home page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite/WebPage JSON-LD plus Open Graph and Twitter preview metadata.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but core security headers are absent and one cookie is not Secure.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, or nosniff; cookies primitive found cw0125088f without Secure or HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, a restrictive nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff, and Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookie attributes appropriate to each cookie.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced clickjacking, referrer, and permissions defenses are not configured.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; all cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies, and narrow SameSite=None to cookies that truly require cross-site use.

findings.summary: The Arabic layout does not explicitly declare direction and relies heavily on physical CSS.
findings.evidence: DOM has lang=ar-sa but no dir; CSS probe found no logical properties and 846 left/right declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir=rtl and migrate layout primitives to inline/block logical properties so translation and bidi content remain robust.

findings.summary: Consent and promotional defaults are coercive.
findings.evidence: The first viewport is blocked by a promotional modal, while the consent banner exposes only “Agree” with no equivalent reject/manage choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the forced promotion and offer equally prominent accept, reject, and manage-consent controls with an easy later reversal.

findings.summary: Lookup validation is generic and not connected to programmatic invalid state.
findings.evidence: Submitting an empty lookup yields three identical “required field” messages, while no controls match :invalid and axe finds missing labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, identify each field in the message, set aria-invalid, connect errors with aria-describedby, and announce a summary.

findings.summary: Forms omit useful autocomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found blank autocomplete values for lookup fields and autocomplete=off for CAPTCHA; inspected sign-in is a primary account path.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct autocomplete tokens to identity/sign-in fields and suitable inputmode tokens to numeric identifiers.

findings.summary: Image delivery lacks basic sizing and responsive optimization.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 6/6 without dimensions, 3 without srcset, 2 legacy-format images, 2 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and one oversized logo.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources, modern formats where useful, and lazy-load non-critical below-fold imagery.
